title: APCPDCL Corporate Office, Vijayawada
client: Andhra Pradesh Central Power Distribution Company Ltd. (APCPDCL)
category: Architecture · Commercial / Government office · Conventional construction
highlight: Andhra Pradesh's first Net Zero Building
description: The APCPDCL corporate office is Andhra Pradesh's first Net Zero building. APCPDCL was formed on 5 December 2019 to serve the electricity needs of seven districts of Andhra Pradesh. The new headquarters houses Operations & Maintenance, Customer Service and Assessment departments, plus Planning, Projects, Telecom, IT & SAP, SCADA, Civil and P&MM wings. Director rooms and a conference hall are on the third floor. The building is now constructed.
